guard: the guards in fork.ts that NO cell was written for
why: Every mutation in fork-cut.json was authored against a cell that had just been written for it,
so 10/10 killed measures the guards that were aimed at and says nothing about the rest. This
config is the opposite experiment: it mutates guards NO cell was written for and PREDICTS
SURVIVED. A survivor here is a finding — a guard nothing is watching — not a failure.
It carries two positive controls that predict KILLED. Without them a batch of survivors is
ambiguous between 'these guards are unasserted' and 'the suite did not run at all', which are
the same observation from outside. The controls are what make the survivors mean something.

mutations.name: CONTROL (expect KILLED): the L5002 refusal for a fork onto a new program is skipped
mutations.expectRed: a fork onto a new program is refused, because nothing pins a program hash
mutations.cell: a fork onto a new program is refused, because nothing pins a program hash

mutations.name: CONTROL (expect KILLED): the L5018 refusal for a cut never reached is skipped
mutations.expectRed: with L5018, because a cut never reached is the whole journal
mutations.cell: with L5018, because a cut never reached is the whole journal

mutations.name: PROBE (expect SURVIVED): an unwalkable scope on the way to the cut raises no L5014
mutations.replace:
} else if (err instanceof UnwalkableScope) {
      /* mutated: the refusal is dropped */
mutations.expectRed: (none — L5014 and UnwalkableScope appear ZERO times in the suite)
mutations.cell: the walk could not enter a scope on the way to the cut

mutations.name: PROBE (expect SURVIVED): an unexpected error class is swallowed instead of rethrown
mutations.find: } else if (!(err instanceof ForkFrontier) && !(err instanceof JournalReadOnlyError)) {
mutations.expectRed: (none known — no cell drives an unexpected error class through planFork)
mutations.cell: an unexpected error class propagates out of planFork

mutations.name: PROBE (expect SURVIVED): unwrapCut's self-referential-reason stop is removed
mutations.find: if (inner === undefined || inner === cur) return cur;
mutations.expectRed: (none known — no cell builds an error whose `reason` points at itself)
mutations.cell: unwrapCut terminates on a self-referential reason
